verdicts.reason: A: the phone is stranded far left with a big empty gap before the copy. SOLSTICE floats above and to the left of the headline instead of lining up with it. The CTA is stacked under a badge at the same width, so it reads as just another pill, and the right ~170px of the canvas is dead space. B: the layout reads left to right properly, with brand and a one-line headline, then subcopy and badges, then the CTA. However, the phone is cropped at the top and bottom edges, the CTA label is jammed against the sides of its pill, and the button sits tight to the right edge.
